_design_note: Single-factor ablation of terminal_on_truncation against the canonical A03_E00 arm (runs/r01_a03_nolag_20260826). The sole difference is the TD target of a round that survives to the MAX_STEPS limit: false bootstraps it as a time-limit truncation (Pardo et al. 2018), true cuts the return with target = r. Reward version, exploration, state, model, learner, seeds, budgets, checkpoint policy and every evaluation suite are byte-for-byte identical by construction. A round that ends because nothing is left to do is unaffected: that is a real terminal state under either setting. See docs/05 sections 1.5 and 1.10.

_predeclared_design_numbers.note: The switch can only touch rounds that reach the step limit. The canonical A03 arm has 12 such rounds in 2500, so the predeclared expectation is a small effect. A large one would mean the switch reaches something other than the truncated rounds and must be investigated rather than reported.
